verdict.rationale: Kintsugi is an automated sales-tax compliance platform: it syncs transactions, determines nexus, and files and remits on schedule. Asking whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back is a fair question for it, but the evidence documents nothing of the kind. Credit notes adjust individual sales and API-key rotation manages credentials; neither versions or rolls back automation configuration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
